title: hostCompliance
description: A host's compliance declaration (fuaran-core Phase 484, DECISIONS.md D228): committed as `host-compliance.json` at the host's own root, it names, for rows of Core's claims ladder (proofs.json), the evidence the host offers. This schema is the SHAPE; whether the declaration is TRUE is Core's validator's question (`dotnet run --project tools/Fuaran.Core.Tools -- compliance <file>`, from the Core checkout `coreVersion` names), which reads the evidence map, the family manifests' adoption records and the host-premise rows. docs/host-compliance.md states every refusal and the verdict.

host.description: The host key, as the family manifests' adoption records key it (`fuaran-core-rs`).

coreVersion.description: The Core version the declaration is judged by: the validator refuses a declaration naming any other version than the checkout running it.

rows.description: One entry per ladder row the host declares. A row the evidence map offers anything for and the declaration omits reads `undeclared`, which withholds `compliant`; a row it offers nothing for may be omitted.

evidence.description: At least one piece of evidence; `not-covered` stands alone.
One piece of evidence. The class set is CLOSED: a further class joins only by a recorded decision amending this enumeration, the validator and the page together.

vector-certified.description: The host's leg ran a vector family the evidence map offers for the row and asserted `cases` of its vectors: exactly the count the family manifest's adoption record carries for the host.

oracle-differential.description: The host's own fuzzer drove the oracle process on `inputs` inputs from `seed`, asking `function` of `model` (the row's model), and found no disagreement.

host-premise.description: The host discharged a `host-premise` row on its own runtime: its leg reproduced every vector of the row's probe, as the probe's adoption record carries.

not-covered.description: The host offers nothing for the row, and says why.
